summary: Verified defensive hardening of self-heal endpoint (asyncio.to_thread + asyncio.wait_for 5s). All 33 tier + QA regression tests pass. Self-heal endpoint returns cached state in ~0.2s for a never-paid session (well below 8s ceiling). Unknown session still 404s. Backend startup clean. Production sweep on https://zynthoro.ai all 200.

self_heal_timing.verdict: well within budget; asyncio.wait_for wrapper active

self_heal_semantics.never_paid_session: 200 with payment_status='initiated', provisioned=false, self-heal did not raise or hang

test_results.backend_startup: clean — 'Application startup complete.' in logs; no Traceback in recent window

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2689 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, tier, ai, webhook) once next stable window opens.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') triggers DeprecationWarning — migrate to lifespan handler.

Self-heal try/except correctly imports stripe locally to avoid a hot-path top-of-module dependency; timeout branch and general exception branch both log and fall through to cached state — good defensive design.
